flavour_text: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

name: Dartrix
flavour_text: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

name: Fomantis

name: Bounsweet

name: Steenee

name: Wimpod

name: Tapu Bulu

name: Growlithe

name: Arcanine

name: Alolan Marowak

name: Fletchinder

name: Talonflame

name: Litten

1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Litten

1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Alolan Sandslash

name: Alolan Vulpix

name: Alolan Ninetales

flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Shellder

name: Cloyster

name: Lapras

name: Bruxish

name: Makuhita

name: Trubbish
flavour_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor

name: Toxapex

name: Alolan Diglett

name: Delcatty

name: Hawlucha

name: Trumbeak

name: Gumshoos

name: Stufful

card_text: Put a random Basic [ W ] Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Rare Candy
card_text: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

name: Rotom Dex
card_text: Look at the top card of your deck. Then, you may shuffle your deck.

name: Poison Barb
card_text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, the Attacking Pokémon is now Poisoned.

name: Leaf Cape
card_text: The [ G ] Pokémon this card is attached to gets +30 HP.

name: Acerola
card_text: Choose 1 of your Palossand or Mimikyu that has damage on it, and move 40 of its damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Ilima
card_text: Put 1 of your [ C ] Pokémon that has damage on it into your hand.

name: Kiawe
card_text: Choose 1 of your Alolan Marowak or Turtonator. Take 2 [ R ] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon. Your turn ends.

name: Guzma
card_text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Lana
card_text: You can use this card only if you have Araquanid in play. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

name: Sophocles
card_text: During this turn, attacks used by your Alolan Golem, Vikavolt, or Togedemaru do +30 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

name: Mallow
card_text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Shiinotic or Tsareena. If you do, discard all Energy from that Pokémon.

name: Lillie
card_text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Stage 2 Pokemon.

name: Alolan Exeggutor

1.name: Tropical Hammer
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Tsareena

1.name: Three Kick Combo
1.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Tapu Bulu

1.name: Stuck-In Tackle
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, it’s violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Alolan Marowak

1.name: Burning Bonemerang
1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If at least 1 of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: This Pokémon sets the bone it holds on fire and dances through the night as a way to mourn its fallen allies.

name: Turtonator

1.name: Fire Spin
1.effect: Discard a [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

name: Alolan Vulpix

1.name: Call Forth Cold
1.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: After long years in the ever-snowcapped mountains of Alola, this Vulpix has gained power over ice.

name: Pyukumuku

ability.name: Innards Out
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 50 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

name: Tapu Fini

1.name: Spiral Drain
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.

name: Oricorio

ability.name: Safeguard
ability.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.

flavour_text: This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar. It uses nimble steps to approach opponents, then knocks them out with electric punches.

name: Tapu Koko

1.name: Volt Switch
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched [L] Pokémon.

flavour_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.

name: Cutiefly
flavour_text: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.

name: Comfey

ability.name: Flower Shield
ability.effect: Each of your Pokémon that has any [P] Energy attached recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

flavour_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won’t wither once they’re attached to a Comfey.

name: Sandygast
flavour_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Tapu Lele

1.name: Energy Arrow
1.effect: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy attached to that Pokémon.

flavour_text: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.

name: Cosmog

1.name: Teleport
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Rockruff

1.name: Signs of Evolution
1.effect: Put a random card that evolves from Rockruff from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Mudsdale

1.name: High Horsepower
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 40 damage to itself.

flavour_text: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

name: Minior

1.name: Star Drop
1.effect: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Places where Minior fall from the night sky are few and far between, with Alola being one of the precious few.

name: Magearna

1.name: Silver Cannon
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.

name: Drampa

1.name: Berserk
1.effect: If any of your Benched Pokémon have damage on them, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Pikipek
flavour_text: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.

name: Bewear

1.name: Tantrum
1.effect: This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavour_text: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

name: Komala

ability.name: Comatose
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever you attach an Energy from your Energy Zone to it, it is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

1.name: Pierce the Pain
1.effect: This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that have damage on them.

1.name: Anchor Shot
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

1.name: Fire Fang
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

2.name: Scar-Charged Smash
2.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

1.name: Insatiable Striking
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Insatiable Striking attack does +40 damage.

1.name: School Storm
1.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Wishiwashi or Wishiwashi ex.

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Psychic Connect
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may move all [P] Energy from 1 of your Benched [P] Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

ability.name: Offload Pass
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, move all [F] Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

1.name: Chemical Panic
1.effect: 1 Special Condition from among Asleep, Burned, Confused, Paralyzed, and Poisoned is chosen at random, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. Any Special Conditions already affecting that Pokémon will not be chosen.

ability.name: Rising Road
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may switch it with your Active Pokémon.

1.name: Sol Breaker
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Venusaur

1.name: Mega Drain
1.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise

1.name: Hydro Pump
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [W] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

name: Gastly

1.name: Astonish
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent reveals a random card from their hand and shuffles it into their deck.

flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar

1.name: Bother
1.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Machop
flavour_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavour_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp

1.name: Power Press
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [F] Energy attached, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Cubone

1.name: Growl
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do -20 damage.

flavour_text: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.

name: Wigglytuff

ability.name: Comforting Song
ability.effect: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

2.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra [W] Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand.

1.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
